title: Curcumin encapsulation via protein-stabilized emulsions: comparative formulation and characterization using whey, soy, and pea proteins
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00526D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Navneet Raj, Shivansh Suman, Dinesh Chandra Rai, Sunil Meena, Raj Kumar Duary, Kamalesh Kumar Meena, Shubham Mishra
Curcumin encapsulation comparing plant vs whey proteins found whey superior, making color. Particle size and zeta potential were comparable. FT-IR confirmed a curcumin–protein complex. Stable curcumin formed, suitable for functional products.
